tools.name: find_actions
tools.description: Finds the actions the installed plug-ins offer agents, each with its plug-in, whether it reads, changes your data or sends, and its input schema. A listed action proves nothing about what calling it will do.

query.description: Words an action's name or its plug-in's must hold; null for every action.

tools.name: call_action
tools.description: Calls a plug-in action by name with a request ID. A read runs; a change needs your standing rule or an ask, and a send always asks: until you answer, it returns held with the ask, and you call again with the same request ID. A change or send returns the plug-in's report and what the hub recorded it changed; the report is the plug-in's statement, never a check result.

action.description: The action, by the name find_actions gave, ext.<plugin>.<name>.

request.description: A request ID of your own for this call: a retry with the same ID and input runs nothing twice, and the same ID with other input is refused.

input.description: The action's input as one string holding its JSON text, held to the input schema find_actions gave.

codes.meaning: The call holds a field its tool's schema doesn't list. The hub refuses it rather than ignore it, since an ignored field could have meant anything.
codes.fix: Send only the fields the tool's schema lists.

codes.meaning: A field the schema requires is missing or null.
codes.fix: Give the field the error's path names.

codes.meaning: A field holds a value of the wrong type, such as a number where the schema takes a string.
codes.fix: Give the field the type its schema names.

codes.meaning: A field holds a value off its list: a check the repo's spec doesn't name, or a kind the tool doesn't take.
codes.fix: Give one of the values the remediation lists; a check's name is as the repo's .deepbuild/done.yaml writes it.

codes.meaning: A field holds a string not in the form its schema gives, such as a commit that isn't a full SHA.
codes.fix: Give the value in the form the remediation names.

codes.meaning: What the call names doesn't exist for this session: a file outside its working folder or missing, an ask or a claim of another session or none.
codes.fix: Name a file in your working folder, or an ask or claim this session made.

codes.meaning: The call binds to no session: its deep mcp's parent is no live session's agent, the session has ended, or more than one stamped PreToolUse matches it. It may read only what belongs to no session.
codes.fix: Call from the agent session's own deep mcp; a new session gets its own binding from its hooks.

codes.meaning: The DeepBuild hub can't be reached, or can't record right now. Nothing was recorded, and nothing succeeded.
codes.fix: Call again once the hub is back; deep mcp reconnects by itself.
